## PROBLEM
The external Core K5 edge is persisted but not enforced by the local ready view without federation.

## SUCCESS
Close only after Core xtrm-ozknq.11 records an approved production promotion.

## SCOPE
Read-only Core promotion evidence check after xtmux K4.

## NON_GOALS
Do not decide parity from xtmux or publish before authorization.

## CONSTRAINTS
Record the Core gate decision, GATE-IFACE evidence reference, parity matrix reference, and compatible versions.

## VALIDATION
Verify Core K5 is closed as promoted, not rejected or waived.

## OUTPUT
A local synchronization gate that blocks the xtmux compatibility release.
source.title: Gate: observe Core K5 production promotion authorization
